rows.text: The key to piloting Choco, Seeker of Paradise is understanding its core engine: Choco turns every evasive Bird attack into library digging and land ramp. While lands enter tapped, Amulet of Vigor and Lotus Cobra turn that ramp into immediate mana, and Scute Swarm triggers exponentially to overwhelm opponents with an aerial and land swarm.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Rhystic Study, Cyclonic Rift, Teferi's Protection. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
